message.content:
It’s a classic “card‑suit” joke:  
**The player who wins the pot has the most hearts—because they’ve got the most “heart” in the game!**  

(If you’re looking for the literal card count, in Texas Hold’em the most hearts a single player can ever hold is 7—if all seven cards (the two hole cards plus the five community cards) happen to be hearts.  In a single hand, the maximum hearts you can actually use is 5, since there are only five community cards.)
